title: Add Comments independently to personal and global views
steps: Inspect the loaded Personal View with Status already in its display list and Global View available in the tab selector.
Select Comments in the personal add-option dropdown and click Add; inspect the Comments row in the personal list.
Switch to Global View, open its add-option dropdown, and search for Comments.

video_guide.summary: Add Comments to Personal View, then inspect the Comments search results in Global View.

chapters.label: Inspect the Computer display preferences in Personal View.
Open the personal add-field dropdown and search for Comments.
Select ordinary Comments and click Add.

chapters.note: Personal View lists Status and Comments.

chapters.label: Switch to Global View in the same modal.
Open the global add-field dropdown and search for Comments.

chapters.note: The visible results offer Location comments and Comments on financial and administrative information; ordinary Comments is absent.
